events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

headlines.description: Tony Romo threw for three touchdowns, two to new-found favorite receiver Kevin Ogletree, and the Dallas Cowboys beat the Super Bowl champion New York Giants 24-17 on Wednesday night in the NFL season opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Romo tosses 3 TDs as Cowboys upend Giants

headlines.description: Jay Cutler threw for 333 yards and two touchdowns, Michael Bush added a pair of scoring runs and the Chicago Bears spoiled Andrew Luck's debut in beating the Indianapolis Colts 41-21 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cutler, Bears blow out Colts in Luck's debut

headlines.description: Michael Vick overcame four interceptions by throwing a 4-yard touchdown pass to Clay Harbor with 1:18 left as the Philadelphia Eagles opened the season with a nerve-racking 17-16 win over the Cleveland Browns.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles escape Browns despite Vick's 4 picks

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw a 5-yard touchdown pass to Kevin Smith with 10 seconds left, lifting the Detroit Lions to a 27-23 win over the St. Louis Rams on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford's winning TD lifts Lions over Rams

events.name: New England Patriots at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for 236 yards and two touchdowns, and the defending AFC champion New England Patriots routed the Tennessee Titans 34-13 for their ninth straight season-opening win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady throws for two TDs as Pats rout Titans

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw for 299 yards and three touchdowns, one of them to Tony Gonzalez in his return to Kansas City, and the Atlanta Falcons pounded the short-handed Chiefs 40-24 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan's huge day (4 TDs) lifts Falcons to rout

headlines.description: Rookie Blair Walsh kicked four field goals, including a 55-yarder as regulation time expired and another one in overtime, and Adrian Peterson returned from a left knee injury to lift the Minnesota Vikings to a 26-23 victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings win OT thriller in Peterson's return

events.name: Washington Redskins at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Robert Griffin III began his NFL career by connecting on 19 of 26 passes for 320 yards and two touchdowns, and the Washington Redskins handed the Saints a 40-32 loss in their first game since the bounty scandal that overshadowed New Orleans' offseason.
headlines.shortLinkText: Griffin dazzles in debut as Redskins stun Saints

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

headlines.description: Mark Sanchez threw three touchdown passes, including two to rookie Stephen Hill, and the New York Jets eased concerns about their offense with a 48-28 rout of the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets soar past Bills behind Sanchez's 3 TDs

headlines.description: Arian Foster had two touchdown runs, Matt Schaub threw a TD pass to Andre Johnson, and Houston's defense dominated rookie Ryan Tannehill and Miami in the Texans' 30-10 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foster (2 TDs), Texans silence Tannehill, Fins

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: San Francisco's defense smothered Aaron Rodgers and the Green Bay offense for most of the game, then made one last stand to stop a late rally as the 49ers beat the Packers 30-22 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Niners lean on defense to upend Rodgers, Pack

headlines.description: Kevin Kolb replaced the injured John Skelton and led Arizona on the deciding touchdown drive, throwing 6 yards to Andre Roberts for a score with 4:59 to play, and the Cardinals held on to beat the Seattle Seahawks 20-16 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kolb, in for injured Skelton, helps Cards to win

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Tampa Bay's rejuvenated defense came up with two interceptions against Cam Newton, and the Buccaneers won their debut under coach Greg Schiano, 16-7 over the Panthers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bucs pick off Newton twice, take down Panthers

headlines.description: Peyton Manning made a successful NFL return from a year's sabbatical, leading the Broncos past the Pittsburgh Steelers 31-19 in his Denver debut Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peyton throws 400th TD, wins in Broncos debut

headlines.description: Joe Flacco threw for 299 yards and two touchdowns, Ed Reed took an interception 34 yards for a score, and the Baltimore Ravens beat the Cincinnati Bengals 44-13 on Monday night for their 11th straight win at home.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco, Rice pace Ravens to blowout of Bengals

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw a 6-yard touchdown pass to Malcom Floyd and Nate Kaeding kicked five field goals to spoil Dennis Allen's debut as Oakland coach by beating the Raiders 22-14 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers feast on Raiders miscues to earn win
